## Checklist

- [ ] `make lint typecheck security test` passes locally
- [ ] New behaviour is covered by tests (coverage gate is 85%)
- [ ] Public API or schema changes are reflected in `docs/API.md` / the OpenAPI document
- [ ] Architecture-level decisions are recorded as an ADR in `docs/adr/`
- [ ] If the retrieval engine changed, `make experiment` was re-run and `experiments/results/` updated
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` has an entry under *Unreleased*
